name: Mercure Kuta Bali
short_description: A 130-room Mercure directly on Kuta Beach with a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (64 reviews), positioned for both leisure and business travellers.
ai_summary: Mercure Kuta Bali sits directly on the shores of Kuta Beach, offering 130 rooms that blend contemporary design with island styling. The hotel holds a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 64 reviews. It's positioned as a gateway to Bali's beach lifestyle for both leisure travellers and business guests. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: Jalan Pantai Kuta 10 X, Br Pande Mas, 80361 Kuta, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 130 rooms directly on Kuta Beach — genuine beachfront positioning
Strong 4.7/5 ALL Rating, though from a modest review base (64 reviews)
cons: Review volume (64) is small relative to other Kuta-area Accor properties, so the rating carries less statistical weight
Kuta Beach strip is busy and tourist-dense
research_watchouts: Rating is based on a relatively small review sample (64) — treat as indicative rather than statistically robust

source_mix.label: Accor ALL — Mercure Kuta Bali official page
